$comment: Spec 392 — THE LIVE GATES LEDGER. Every wave's live verify script, with the authority twin it carries, run nightly against faithnet by scripts/live-gates.mts. No secrets: the demo personas sign in openly and sign through the Home's persona-sign. `required` gates fail the run; the rest report. `paced` gates make model calls on a metered plan and are spaced out.

gates.proves: every model call names its provider and the numbers it was routed by; the run reads as a span tree; the reply names its provenance; a large result leaves the record for the vault
gates.twin: a route is decided before the call and recorded — a failed provider is a failure, never a re-send to another

gates.proves: a routed ask reads as two bundles joined from either side; every reply says where its provenance is; PROV-N is served
gates.twin: neither graph carries the ask's words

gates.proves: a payment's spans carry the verdict and the receipt digest; the record's provenance lands in the vault
gates.twin: no span carries the payee's address, the treasury's name or the utterance (read from the record's own result, never guessed)

gates.proves: the verified delegation chain is on the receipt: root, links, digest
gates.twin: a forged child without its parent is refused chain-parent-missing before any caveat is read

gates.proves: a step handed to a specialist runs under a child mandate cut from the parent's; the child's run is cited on the receipt
gates.twin: the same child presented for a second step is denied — single use

gates.proves: a run that stopped to ask a person resumes: the completed step replays from its receipt, the pending step is re-verified
gates.twin: a run whose window closed lists as expired and a resume is refused with that word

gates.proves: a grant revoked on chain refuses the next step
gates.twin: the revocation IS the twin: a recorded allow is never replayed as permission

gates.proves: discover → inspect → invoke through the gateway; the ministry's agent answers from its own catalog
gates.twin: the invoke posts ONLY to the endpoint the handle pinned; a changed card is said, not followed

gates.proves: every hop of the outside-in flow with its output; the run joins the gateway's W3C trace
gates.twin: the trace id correlates; the target admitted on the signed caller assertion

gates.proves: a steward raises a decision naming an approver; the named approver records it once; the detail carries the record; the approver's My Work listed it pending before and nothing after
gates.twin: a non-approver refused (403); an UN-NAMED steward refused in those words; a second record on the closed request refused (409)

gates.proves: a member's offer and the steward's allocation go through the Ask with supplied plans — the offer under the OFFERER's own mandate, the allocation under the organization's granted by its steward; the endeavor carries one allocation
gates.twin: an outsider's offer, under their own mandate, refused at the organization's member gate; a member's allocation cannot be authorized — the organization's mandate is not theirs to give

gates.proves: a standing instruction is kept from the person's yes to the read-back, listed, and fills an UNSPOKEN acting party cited `standing`; the payment still waits on its mandate
gates.twin: a spoken payer is never overridden by the instruction; once cleared, the instruction fills nothing

gates.proves: a run's anchored outcomes are readable by anyone with no session — digests and ids through the S1 firewall, the receipt digest equal to the private graph's, the transaction as the anchor
gates.twin: no address and nothing the run was about in the rows; a run with no transaction projects nothing (every step refused by name); an unknown run is 404

gates.proves: every InteractionsDO op reports its vault-call bill on its headers; the listing an organization's members open most costs what the index says, not one call per endeavor
gates.twin: advisory — the numbers are the gate; a listing that costs more than a handful of calls per viewer is the regression to read in the morning

gates.proves: a receipt's holder recomputes its digest and the agent's public projection, with no session, names the transaction anchoring it
gates.twin: a receipt changed in one field anchors nothing

gates.proves: the acting context is a namespace — a default declared while addressing an organization fills the payer there; one declared at home applies everywhere the person has not said otherwise
gates.twin: the organization's default is NOT read at home

gates.proves: a run's record carries its own bill — vault calls and DO requests by the step that made them — and its metrics carry ap.vault.calls
gates.twin: the bill is numbers and step refs only — no record type, no argument, no address

gates.proves: a confirmed choice made while addressing an organization is kept for that room and cited there on the next ask
gates.twin: the organization's choice is NOT read at home — the question comes back

gates.proves: a routed write parked at an organization on Home B resumes the asker's run on Home A under the subject agent's session wire
gates.twin: B's completion presented without the wire is refused at A

gates.proves: a child mandate cut on A is redeemed by a specialist on B under the parent agent's own session wire
gates.twin: the parent revokes the child and B is denied at its own gate

gates.proves: a three-link chain across two Homes verifies from either side
gates.twin: a link presented by reference only is chain-parent-missing

gates.proves: an MCP client registers itself (RFC 7591), alice connects through the Home (ask-as-me), a PKCE code becomes an opaque bearer bound to /mcp, initialize → tools/list → ask answers from HER agent with HER standing under her delegation to the Home MCP's key
gates.twin: the bearer at her agent directly is refused; a token for another resource is refused; a second client's connection cannot resume her run; a revoked bearer is 401

gates.proves: through the Home MCP, alice's agent finds Ligonier in the public registry (discovery.agents.find) and engages it as her (engagement.agent.invoke → the routed whole ask under her forwarded credential); Ligonier's agent plans under its own content-catalog playbook and answers a six-week study with links; the reply names the ministry as the source and her run records the hop
gates.twin: an unknown name is refused in words; the other agent's answer is an observation — no authority is asked of her

gates.proves: the browser connect path replayed headlessly: /oauth/authorize → the Home's connect (client home-mcp, template ask-as-me, the Home MCP's PKCE + state) → authorize-grant → the person's ask-as-me wire signed prompt-free via persona-sign → /oidc/grant → the Home MCP callback exchanges at /token, verifies the id_token and the wire, answers the client its code → a bearer that lists tools
gates.twin: the Home's grant endpoint accepts only a wire to the REGISTERED delegate (SEC-001) — a wire to any other key is refused there

gates.proves: a payment asked through Claude parks authority_required; grant_link names her Home's /you?run= page; resumed at her Home under her session with the mandate she signs, the payment runs; Claude's run tool reads the receipt with the transaction and ask { run } on the finished run answers its record
gates.twin: Claude's ask { run } before she granted is authority_required again — never a payment; the record view carries no signature

gates.proves: her Home lists the Home MCP connection under Connected assistants with its wire; revoked on chain from her own account (what the panel's Revoke does), the chain says isRevoked
gates.twin: Claude's next ask is refused at her agent in its words and the Home MCP says she must authorize again; the bearer alone is worth nothing; the row is gone

gates.proves: a client that accepts an event stream gets progress notifications as her agent says what it is doing, then the result; a data question is put to the HOST as an MCP elicitation built from the agent's fields and the answer continues the run on the same session; resources serve the doctrine and her agent's public card
gates.twin: a signature is never elicited — the parked act ends the stream with authority_required

gates.proves: a standing instruction declared through Claude (read back, confirmed through the host) is her agent's: a payment through Claude with no payer parks naming it
gates.twin: the app is not a room — the instruction is listed at her Home under her session and forgetting it there forgets it for Claude

gates.proves: through Claude, alice asks missio-nexus.org by name; the organization's agent derives her standing and answers its roster; a standing instruction declared at the room through Claude is listed under that room at her Home and cleared there
gates.twin: an unregistered room name is refused before anything is asked; the room's instruction is not her own agent's default

gates.proves: through the host: an engagement asked AT an organization routes under her forwarded credential (the profile names the room); a target's data question parks HER run and ask { run, supplied } continues the TARGET's run; a streamed engage relays the target's own progress lines
gates.twin: a read's question never asks her authority (prompt, not authority_required)

gates.proves: through Claude: an invitation asked AT an organization parks, is approved at her Home on the one-prompt path, finishes with the signed invitation the Home's half records, and the organization lists the invitee; her own household records answer; a card is inspected through its name's records with the pin verdict
gates.twin: another person's records are refused without stewardship; a read never asks her authority

gates.proves: a run parked on authority is listed as awaiting-approval (the projected word); its asker stops it; the runtime says after how many steps; the run leaves the parked list, a resume is refused, and the record is kept and marked canceled — never failed
gates.twin: another person cannot stop it — a cancel is as much the asker's as a resume (claimableBy); stopping withdraws no authority (that is a revocation) and undoes nothing

gates.proves: the first demonstration as far as it runs, read through the Home's own projections: a charter parks and Today lists it under needs-my-decision as awaiting-approval; granted, custodian named, signed → done and gone from Today; the inspector shows a completed run with a verified, receipted step; the organization adopts the first event as an accountable work item (owner, state, acceptance); a decision request naming carol is on her Today, recorded once, gone
gates.twin: T06 inline — a different question may not ride the run's mandate; T11 verify-cancel, T07 verify-grant-revocation, T05 verify-ask-surface by their own gates. NOT YET: specialist allocations with artifacts on the item, the run's own send decision, publishing the page artifact — named in the script, never faked; the parity pair (§7.2 (4)) is check:interaction-coverage:behaviour (249 pairs)

gates.proves: a steward pauses a routine (listed as blocked; "fire now" refused with the pause named) and resumes it; with a budget of 1 vault call the firing HAPPENS and the routine pauses itself by budget with the numbers on the row
gates.twin: a non-steward can neither pause nor budget it; a pause is not a cancel (the firing that went over stood, its record kept) and not a revoke (no authority changed hands); the budget never widens a mandate or tops up

gates.proves: a completed run (a supplied-plan read) becomes a draft SKILL.md recipe — the capability named, the organization written as a role, no address in its steps, no credential value, authority requested anew — saved into her Library as a skill artifact under recipes/ (content commitment matches) and removed
gates.twin: a run that did not complete (a payment parked for authority) is refused as a recipe by name; the draft is compiled from the record and the playbook only — the keyring is not an input

gates.proves: an outside ACP runtime joins a workspace as a .svc member (its own key, the custodian's session wire, its playbook), receives the steward's message through its own inbox as itself, answers through the ACP agent — its local shell refused by policy, the workspace's tools allowed — its reply parks for the steward's mandate and lands when she signs FOR it, it reads the roster as a member; revoked on chain, it is refused everywhere
gates.twin: the session wire revoked on chain by the custodian: the next wire-signed request is refused; the host refuses the agent's local shell by default

gates.proves: a runtime member hosted on a Cloudflare Container next to the Worker is WOKEN, never polled: the steward's message is admitted into the member's inbox, the Worker enqueues one wake (no content, no authority), the consumer wakes the member's Container, the ACP host inside runs one pass — the agent prompted with the steward's words, its local shell refused, the workspace tool allowed — and the reply LANDS under the OPEN MANDATE (W2a: a standing grant the steward signed once, the child the runtime derived for this intent, the chain verified by the harness, the message on the member's own rail) with no signature; the receipt on the member's object names both refs
gates.twin: the custodian clears the host declaration: another message is admitted and nothing is woken (the Worker wakes only what it was told about); the declaration restored

gates.proves: a runtime joins a workspace with a CODE the custodian minted at her Home and nothing else — no session, no persona key: the code is claimed with a key the runtime generated, the custodian sees the claim (the key, the agent) and approves, her signatures equip the member for THAT key (wire, steward link, vault key, playbook, rail), the record crosses back through the code and the runtime takes it ONCE, then reads its own inbox as the member
gates.twin: a second key cannot claim the code; the record cannot be taken twice; a cancelled code is unknown to the runtime

gates.proves: a fact the person tells her own agent ('remember that …') is kept in her vault, listed back with when and who said it, shown by the Home's memory route, and forgotten on her word — gone everywhere; memory that follows the person because every way in asks the same agent
gates.twin: her organization's agent, addressed with the same read, does not read her memory (a room keeps its own records); another person's agent remembers nothing of hers

gates.proves: a mention in a topic is a turn put to the mentioned MEMBER agent in that thread, not a new Ask: the org's object resolves @label to a member and admits the post into its inbox on the topic's thread; the member's runtime is woken and answers IN THE TOPIC as itself (messaging.topic.post, under its open mandate); a second mention continues the same run (one session per thread — turn N then N+1)
gates.twin: the same handle mentioned in a topic of an organization the member does not belong to admits nothing and wakes nothing (20s)

gates.proves: search over one's own work from rebuildable DO-side indexes (never an engine over decrypted copies): a direct message is indexed the moment it is admitted and its recipient finds it by words, cited by conversation and message id; a topic post is found by the org's steward, cited by org, topic and post; every result names where it lives; a rebuild (search.reindex) leaves the sent copy findable
gates.twin: a member finds nothing in an organization they do not steward; an outsider finds nothing of a message that was never theirs

gates.proves: one screen of every grant an agent issued (access.grants.audit — apps, members' access delegations, contacts, runtimes' standing grants, a coach's study grant; holder, what, digest, the chain's word): the steward audits the organization she stewards and the runtime she custodies, revokes the runtime's standing grant BY DIGEST under the issuer's mandate (a transaction), and the audit reflects it; then grants anew
gates.twin: a member who stewards nothing here, and an outsider, get nothing of the organization's grants

gates.proves: the review loop on GitHub as the forge, under the delegation model: the organization's connector credential is the platform's (a Worker secret keyed by its name; no agent carries it); its steward reads the repository, OPENS a pull request under the organization's mandate — a branch, a change, a PR whose body names the run's intent digest and the run — reviews it, reads it back as evidence (binding, checks, reviews), and PROMOTES it under a mandate bound to that intent (the high-risk rung's second signature included); the forge shows it merged
gates.twin: a promotion whose ask names another intent digest is refused before the forge is touched (binding mismatch); no token appears in any reply

gates.proves: contacts are membership on the person agent: the steward adds an agent contact under her own mandate (her grant to it, scoped to her contact profile), her list names it with its role, an organization is refused as a contact, the contact cannot list her contacts, and removing it revokes the grant on chain and drops it from her list
gates.twin: an organization refused as a contact; the contact refused her contacts list; a removed contact's grant revoked on chain (a transaction)
